purpose: Evidence for grouped scene-generation performance tables; numerical values transcribed from primary papers, no experiments run.
comparison_rule: Rank only within each original protocol and source snapshot. Similar metric names across protocols do not establish comparability.

primary_blocks.title: Text-to-room generation: image quality and perceived 3D completeness

visual_check.scope: All five selected complete-pipeline rows and all four numeric columns; ablation rows excluded.

protocol.dataset: Author-defined indoor-room text prompts; not a named public test benchmark
protocol.split: Generated scenes, evaluated from novel viewpoints; exact scene/prompt count not stated in main paper or official supplement
protocol.test_samples: 60 novel-view RGB renderings per scene for CS/IS; 61 human participants; 1098 total user-study datapoints
protocol.input: Text description. Text2Room generation additionally uses 20 predefined trajectories of 10 frames each, followed by completion views.
protocol.evaluation_views: 2D metrics: 60 novel views per scene. Human study: multiple rendered and top-down views, each method rated individually, not pairwise.
protocol.resolution: Evaluation render resolution not reported in inspected main paper or supplement; do not substitute the separate WorldScore 512x512 setting.
protocol.metric_protocol: CS and IS on scene RGB renderings; PQ and 3DS rated on a 1–5 scale, then averaged.
protocol.generation_configuration: Text2Room uses Stable Diffusion inpainting, IronDepth pretrained on ScanNet, mesh edge and normal thresholds both 0.1; approximately 50 minutes per scene on one RTX 3090.
protocol_locations: Main p.5 / printed p.7913, Results implementation, Evaluation Metrics, and Sec.4.2
Official supplement p.1 Sec.D (1098 datapoints), pp.3–5 Sec.F (baseline pipelines)
missing_fields: Random seed and exact baseline checkpoint revisions

rows.configuration_note: Object-centric text-to-NeRF baseline; not a dedicated room generator.
Author-constructed pipeline: Stable Diffusion outpainting, then depth estimation and triangulation.
Original row label Text2Light [11]+Ours. Panorama generation plus depth prediction and the Text2Room mesh-fusion step; do not label as standalone Text2Light.
Original row label Blockade [37]+Ours. Panorama plus depth/mesh extraction. Cited service snapshot accessed 2023-03-04.

scientific_limits: CS/IS are image-based and PQ/3DS are human ratings; none directly measures metric geometric accuracy, collision correctness, interaction latency, or headset quality.
Room generation baselines differ in intended task and are author-constructed complete pipelines. Preserve the +mesh-fusion labels.
These CLIP scores cannot be ranked against SceneScape CLIP-TS or normalized WorldScore content-alignment scores.
Number of scenes and evaluation image resolution remain unreported, limiting reproducibility; do not infer the former from the number of user ratings.

primary_blocks.title: Image-conditioned novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K

visual_check.scope: All five Table 1 rows and PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS, distinct from the right-hand Table 2 reconstruction results.

protocol.split: 150 video clips randomly selected from the test set
protocol.test_samples: 150 video clips; exact clip IDs, evaluation frame count and duration not given
protocol.input: Single image and target camera trajectory; camera parameters and depth are estimated by the Voyager data engine because the evaluated clips lack ground-truth cameras in this setup.
protocol.trajectory_and_depth: VGGT camera/depth estimation; MoGE depth alignment; metric scaling with Metric3D (Sec.4.4 and supplement Sec.C).
protocol.resolution: Test rendering/evaluation resolution not stated in the inspected v1 paper; do not infer from the pretrained HunyuanVideo model.
protocol.sequence_configuration: Supplement Sec.A reports 49 generated frames per single pass; the paper does not explicitly identify 49 as the Table 1 evaluation length.
protocol.metric_protocol: PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS between generated frames and ground-truth video frames; these are synthesis scores, not reconstructed-3DGS scores.
missing_fields: Exact evaluation frame sampling and duration

rows.configuration_note: Camera parameters supplied directly to the model.
RGB-D video diffusion with geometry-conditioned generation; v1 results.

scientific_limits: This is a within-paper comparison on 150 RealEstate10K test clips. Do not combine it with another paper’s PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS results unless the exact scenes, poses, frame selection and resolution match.
Estimated camera/depth conditions are part of the protocol; the metrics do not measure camera calibration accuracy.
Photometric fidelity on held-out real videos does not establish long-horizon world persistence, delivered mesh quality or interactive XR performance.
Table 2 on the same PDF page is a different reconstruction protocol and must remain a separate block if used.

primary_blocks.title: WorldScore: common world-generation benchmark, fixed ICCV 2025 snapshot

visual_check.scope: All 20 method rows and 12 numerical columns; model configuration and 4D-fy budget footnote also viewed in official supplement Table S1 p.2.

protocol.split: Curated evaluation benchmark: 2000 static world specifications; 1000 dynamic world specifications
protocol.test_samples: Static: 10 scene categories (5 indoor, 5 outdoor), each with photorealistic and stylized examples. Dynamic: 5 motion categories. These are world specifications, not physical scenes or human subjects.
protocol.input: Current-scene image and text, next-scene text, and camera matrices plus a text description of camera movement. Model-specific preprocessing passes the supported input forms; T2V models ignore image conditioning.
protocol.trajectories: 8 camera motions: push in, pull out, orbit left/right, move left/right, pan left/right. 80% of static examples specify one new scene, 20% specify three new scenes. Dynamic tasks explicitly use a fixed camera.
protocol.resolution: Method-specific native resolutions, lengths and FPS in each row from official supplement Table S1; images are center-cropped/resized to the model input resolution.
protocol.evaluation: All outputs evaluated as videos. WS_static is the arithmetic mean of 3 controllability + 4 quality scores. WS_dynamic adds 3 motion scores. Every dimension is normalized to 0–100 with higher better.
protocol.compute: Benchmark generations used H100 and L40S GPUs, with unequal per-method runtime; no common computational budget.

metrics.note: Camera pose error is normalized and direction-reversed; not degrees.

metrics.label: Object controllability

metrics.label: Content alignment
metrics.note: Normalized CLIPScore, not comparable to raw Text2Room CS.

metrics.label: 3D consistency
metrics.note: DROID-SLAM-based depth/reprojection measure on generated video; not ground-truth metric reconstruction accuracy.

metrics.label: Subjective quality
metrics.note: Automatic CLIP-IQA+ and CLIP Aesthetic ensemble selected using a separate human study; this column is not a direct participant rating.

rows.configuration_note: Benchmark authors explicitly decrease optimization iteration steps to save time: about 3h per benchmark instance versus about 20h stated for the original generation. This is a reduced-budget benchmark configuration; exclude from a table claiming full-method/full-budget results, or clearly label separately.

scientific_limits: Treat this as a fixed published benchmark snapshot, not a current leaderboard.
Unified task specification does not imply equal input modality, resolution, duration, compute or model scale. Preserve each method’s input and resolution where space permits.
For static 3D methods, zero motion scores are assigned by benchmark policy, not measured motion failures. Prefer WS_static for a spatial-scene comparison.
4D-fy was evaluated with fewer iterations; its result cannot stand for the original full-budget method.
Static consistency scores assess video observations, not collision geometry, persistent object identity under interaction or user-centered XR outcomes.
Do not append Voyager Table 3 to this snapshot without explaining source/version differences; its reported average also has an internal arithmetic inconsistency.

datasets.modalities: Video RGB with camera/depth estimated by the Voyager engine
datasets.split_or_use: The 74766 number is the paper’s source-dataset size, not a verified count of training clips after splitting; 150 is the evaluation subset

datasets.modalities: Real RGB video with estimated geometry
datasets.split_or_use: Used in stage 1; excluded from stage 2 depth training because of camera motion; stage 3 uses only UE

datasets.split_or_use: Combined data engine produces over 100000 video clips across RealEstate, DL3DV and UE; third-stage control training uses UE only

excluded_or_secondary_sources.reason: Not chosen as the main WorldScore source: official benchmark Table 2 provides a broader fixed snapshot with model configuration evidence. Voyager row reports average 77.62, while the seven printed component scores have arithmetic mean 77.902857...; retain 77.62 only as an explicitly source-reported aggregate, do not silently correct it or use it to claim a global ranking.

Two separately designed pairwise protocols (VideoFusion vs SceneScape; GEN-1 vs SceneScape). Do not place the two SceneScape rows and both baselines into one leaderboard. VideoFusion uses 1000 text-to-video samples at 256x256, while GEN-1 comparison uses 22 RealEstate10K trajectories and 5 prompts (110 videos).

Useful optional landscape comparison, but GANcraft and EG3D are explicitly adapted architecture baselines; Inf-Nature is evaluated only on CE/SfM because training data are incompatible. Not needed for the three chosen complete-pipeline comparison blocks.

Table 1 is a layout ablation and was not used as a collection of independent generation methods. Table 2 is downstream ObjectNav agent training, not image/scene generation quality; suitable for a separate downstream-use evidence table.
excluded_or_secondary_sources.configuration: Same ProcTHOR-10K pretrained ObjectNav model (~400M steps) for non-random methods; fine-tuning 100 scenes and 50M steps, separately for each scene type. Test episodes count/resolution not stated in main section.

validation.missing_values_policy: Explicitly state unreported configuration; never infer dataset size, resolution or full-budget status.
